09 · section

Base vs. Advanced: assert, then demonstrate

  • Base — answer the five from judgment. No tooling. Do it Monday.
  • Advanced — demonstrate each one. Costs cycles. Made affordable by agentic workflows.

Everyone can assert five questions once. The advanced tier measures every one of them — for teams with a little more tokens, resources, automation × tooling, you can prove it with receipts.
